The Envoy Part I#000.src: It's an independant island to the west. In fact... If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#000.dst: Es una isla independiente al oeste. De hecho... Si quiere ir...

The Envoy Part I#001.src: The boat is down at the dock.
The Envoy Part I#001.dst: El barco está abajo, en el muelle.

The Envoy Part I#002.src: It's really hard to miss. Just hop on!
The Envoy Part I#002.dst: Es difícil no verlo. ¡Suba a bordo!

The Envoy Part I#003.src: And don't get me sterted on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#003.dst: ¡Y no me hagas hablar de nuestra arquitectura!

The Envoy Part I#004.src: Mo'in, Wynn traveller! Come speak to me.
The Envoy Part I#004.dst: ¡Mo'in, viajero de Wynn! Ven a hablar conmigo.

The Envoy Part I#005.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#005.dst: Al norte puede comprar armas y pociones. Si cruza la puerta, encontrará a los Avos nativos.

The Envoy Part I#006.src: West, you can buy armour, and there is another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#006.dst: Al oeste hay armaduras y otra entrada a la tienda de pociones.

The Envoy Part I#007.src: Something is going on at the diner, you should hurry.
The Envoy Part I#007.dst: Algo pasa en el restaurante, deberías darte prisa.

The Envoy Part I#008.src: Psst! You! Over here, behind the logs!

The Envoy Part I#009.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you!
The Envoy Part I#009.dst: Mo'in, wynniano. ¡Menos mal que te he parado!

The Envoy Part I#010.src: The diner is being raided by mechs...

The Envoy Part I#011.src: You don't know, huh? Of course you don't. Let me explain.
The Envoy Part I#011.dst: ¿No lo sabes? Claro que no. Te lo explico.

The Envoy Part I#012.src: The name's Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#012.dst: Por cierto, me llamo Maxie. Encantado.

The Envoy Part I#013.src: This town is usually full of life...

The Envoy Part I#014.src: Look... I know you're a stranger, but... If you want to help, talk to me.
The Envoy Part I#014.dst: Mira... sé que no eres de aquí, pero... Si quieres ayudar, habla conmigo.

The Envoy Part I#015.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic...
The Envoy Part I#015.dst: Vale, abriré la puerta con electromagia...

The Envoy Part I#018.src: Look, I-I'm sorry for slowing you down. It's just...
The Envoy Part I#018.dst: Oye, s-siento retrasarte. Es solo que...

The Envoy Part I#019.src: Oh, two paths. Well, I'm not sure which way it is, so let's split up. I'll go to the right.
The Envoy Part I#019.dst: Ah, dos caminos. No sé cuál es, así que separémonos. Yo iré por la derecha.

The Envoy Part I#020.src: Mo'in. Sorry, had a problem with the-
The Envoy Part I#020.dst: Mo'in. Perdona, tuve un problema con-

The Envoy Part I#022.src: Don't worry about the guards, they're disabled for now. Follow me!
The Envoy Part I#022.dst: No te preocupes por los guardias, están desactivados. ¡Sígueme!

The Envoy Part I#023.src: We saw a mech… A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
The Envoy Part I#023.dst: Vimos un mech... ¡Un mech nuevo! Parecía distinto, como hecho en-

The Envoy Part I#024.src: Our guest... just killed several despermechs by themselves.
The Envoy Part I#024.dst: Nuestro invitado... ha acabado con varios despermechs sin ayuda.

The Envoy Part I#025.src: Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
The Envoy Part I#025.dst: Ven a mi casa al llegar al nivel {~}; toma una llave para entrar. Debemos preparar el asalto a la fábrica.

The Envoy Part I#031.src: I'm not from around here. In fact I am from Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#031.dst: No soy de por aquí. De hecho, soy de Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#031.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#032.src: It's an independent island to the west. In fact.. If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#032.dst: Es una isla independiente al oeste. De hecho.. Si quiere ir...
The Envoy Part I#032.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#033.src: We're looking for Wynn representatives. Head to the C.S.S Wavebreaker down at the dock if you want to experience Corkus. Enjoy Corkus if you go!
The Envoy Part I#033.dst: Buscamos representantes de Wynn. Si quiere conocer Corkus, vaya al C.S.S Wavebreaker, abajo en el muelle. ¡Disfrute de Corkus si va!
The Envoy Part I#033.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#034.src: Speak to C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain at the {p} docks.
The Envoy Part I#034.dst: Habla con el capitán del C.S.S Wavebreaker en los muelles de {p}.

The Envoy Part I#036.src: The only boat that'll take ye directly to {p}.
The Envoy Part I#036.dst: El único barco que te lleva derecho a {p}.
The Envoy Part I#036.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#037.src: Just hop aboard and make yerself comfy.
The Envoy Part I#037.dst: Sube a bordo y ponte cómodo.
The Envoy Part I#037.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#039.src: Welcam aboard me ship, I'll bring ye directly to Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#039.dst: Bienvenido a mi barco, te llevo derecho a Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#039.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#040.src: Trust me, it is fa' more amazin than Gavel and Wynn. We even 'ave machines!
The Envoy Part I#040.dst: Créeme, es mucho más asombroso que Gavel y Wynn. ¡Hasta tenemos máquinas!
The Envoy Part I#040.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#041.src: And don't get me started on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#041.dst: ¡Y no me hagas hablar de nuestra arquitectura!
The Envoy Part I#041.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#042.src: Trust me, you will enjoy yer stay.
The Envoy Part I#042.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#044.dst: Habla con el delegado de Corkus

The Envoy Part I#045.src: It's such an honour to have a Wynn soldier visit our island.
The Envoy Part I#045.dst: Es un gran honor recibir a un soldado de Wynn en nuestra isla.
The Envoy Part I#045.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#046.src: We were hoping for a true envoy, but you will do.
The Envoy Part I#046.dst: Esperábamos un enviado de verdad, pero usted servirá.
The Envoy Part I#046.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#047.src: If you follow me, I'll give you a tour of the city.
The Envoy Part I#047.dst: Si me sigue, le daré una vuelta por la ciudad.
The Envoy Part I#047.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#048.src: We first arrived on Corkus {~} years ago.
The Envoy Part I#048.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#049.src: The Corkians, like you, are from Fruma originally...
The Envoy Part I#049.dst: Los corkianos, como usted, venimos de Fruma...
The Envoy Part I#049.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#051.src: Coming from Fruma, we of course knew no magic at all.
The Envoy Part I#051.dst: Al venir de Fruma, claro está, no sabíamos nada de magia.
The Envoy Part I#051.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#052.src: We soon developed our own. The rare power of Electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#052.dst: Pronto creamos la nuestra: el raro poder de la electromagia.
The Envoy Part I#052.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#053.src: It's a difficult modern branch of magic that allows us to create machines.
The Envoy Part I#053.dst: Es una rama moderna y difícil que nos permite crear máquinas.
The Envoy Part I#053.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#054.src: Ah, here already. Welcome to {p}, Capital of our island.
The Envoy Part I#054.dst: Ah, ya hemos llegado. Bienvenido a {p}, capital de nuestra isla.
The Envoy Part I#054.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#055.src: We've come a long way in a short time.
The Envoy Part I#055.dst: Hemos avanzado mucho en poco tiempo.
The Envoy Part I#055.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#056.src: Let me point out where the shops are.
The Envoy Part I#056.dst: Le indico dónde están las tiendas.
The Envoy Part I#056.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#057.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you will continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#057.dst: Al norte puede comprar armas y pociones. Si cruza la puerta, encontrará a los Avos nativos.
The Envoy Part I#057.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#058.src: West, you can buy armor, and another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#058.dst: Al oeste hay armaduras y otra entrada a la tienda de pociones.
The Envoy Part I#058.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#059.src: To the south is our bank, powder shop, scrolls, and our exclusive powder exchange!
The Envoy Part I#059.dst: ¡Al sur están el banco, la tienda de polvos, los pergaminos y nuestro exclusivo intercambio de polvos!
The Envoy Part I#059.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#060.src: Oh! And speaking of the powder exchange, I'll start you off with some of these.
The Envoy Part I#060.dst: ¡Ah! Y hablando del intercambio, le doy algunos para empezar.
The Envoy Part I#060.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#061.src: Moving on... The south gate leads to {p}. On your way there, you might pass by the-
The Envoy Part I#061.dst: Sigamos... La puerta sur lleva a {p}. De camino quizá pase junto al-
The Envoy Part I#061.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#062.src: Uhm, nevermind. In fact, we have a gift for you.
The Envoy Part I#062.dst: Eh, olvídelo. De hecho, tenemos un regalo para usted.
The Envoy Part I#062.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#063.src: The Five Gears Diner is hosting any guests of the island.
The Envoy Part I#063.dst: The Five Gears Diner recibe a todos los visitantes de la isla.
The Envoy Part I#063.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#064.src: Go through the western gate and head to the diner for your free feast. Enjoy!
The Envoy Part I#064.dst: Cruce la puerta oeste y vaya al restaurante. ¡El banquete es gratis!
The Envoy Part I#064.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#065.src: Walk towards The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#065.dst: Dirígete a The Five Gears Diner.

The Envoy Part I#069.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you.
The Envoy Part I#069.dst: Mo'in, wynniano. Menos mal que te he parado.
The Envoy Part I#069.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#070.src: The diner is being raided by mechs..
The Envoy Part I#070.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#071.src: Before we do anything, I have to explain what's happening here...
The Envoy Part I#071.dst: Antes de nada, tengo que explicarte qué pasa aquí...
The Envoy Part I#071.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#072.src: My name is Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#072.dst: Por cierto, me llamo Maxie. Encantado de conocerte.
The Envoy Part I#072.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#073.src: This town is usually full of life.
The Envoy Part I#073.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#075.src: Our creations have rebelled against us.
The Envoy Part I#075.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#076.src: They now raid towns for parts.
The Envoy Part I#076.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#077.src: Mechs are getting increasingly more desperate.
The Envoy Part I#077.dst: Los mechs están cada vez más desesperados.
The Envoy Part I#077.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#078.src: Even in rust, they are still powerful.
The Envoy Part I#078.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#079.src: We have tried to remove them but the factory always makes more.
The Envoy Part I#079.dst: Hemos intentado eliminarlos, pero la fábrica siempre hace más.
The Envoy Part I#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#080.src: It is Corkus' greatest failure. It must be stopped.
The Envoy Part I#080.dst: Es el mayor fracaso de Corkus. Hay que detenerlo.
The Envoy Part I#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#082.src: I can try to open the vent to sneak in.
The Envoy Part I#082.dst: Puedo abrir la rejilla y colarnos.
The Envoy Part I#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#083.src: I know you are a stranger, but talk to me if you want to help.
The Envoy Part I#083.dst: Sé que no eres de aquí, pero habla conmigo si quieres ayudar.
The Envoy Part I#083.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#086.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#086.dst: Vale, abriré la puerta con electromagia.
The Envoy Part I#086.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#088.src: Gah! I can't even do the most basic spell!
The Envoy Part I#088.dst: ¡Agh! ¡No me sale ni el hechizo más básico!
The Envoy Part I#088.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#091.src: I'm sorry for being useless in front of you...
The Envoy Part I#091.dst: Siento ser un inútil delante de ti...
The Envoy Part I#091.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#092.src: Electromagic is different from your magic.. I'm not very good at it...
The Envoy Part I#092.dst: La electromagia no es como vuestra magia.. No se me da bien...
The Envoy Part I#092.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#095.src: Open the door and exit the ducts.
The Envoy Part I#095.dst: Abre la puerta y sal de los conductos.

The Envoy Part I#100.src: Mo'in. Sorry had a problem with the-
The Envoy Part I#100.dst: Mo'in. Perdona, tuve un problema con-
The Envoy Part I#100.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#101.src: ...What in the world is that mech on top of the pile of scrap over there?!
The Envoy Part I#101.dst: ...¿¡Qué demonios es ese mech de ahí, sobre la chatarra!?
The Envoy Part I#101.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#102.src: That is definitely not a regular despermech... It looks brand new!
The Envoy Part I#102.dst: Ese no es un despermech normal... ¡Parece nuevecito!
The Envoy Part I#102.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#103.src: One of those hasn't been seen since the factory was running...
The Envoy Part I#103.dst: No se ve uno de esos desde que la fábrica funcionaba...
The Envoy Part I#103.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#104.src: We need to do something! I'll clear the path for you. That's the only thing I can do, I... hurt my... leg.
The Envoy Part I#104.dst: ¡Hay que hacer algo! Yo te abro camino. Es lo único que puedo hacer, me... hice daño... en la pierna.
The Envoy Part I#104.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#108.src: Are you okay? Good. Meet me at the entrance where we met. We need to report to {p}!
The Envoy Part I#108.dst: ¿Estás bien? Bien. Nos vemos en la entrada donde nos conocimos. ¡Hay que informar a {p}!
The Envoy Part I#108.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#109.src: Talk to Maxie at the entrance to The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#109.dst: Habla con Maxie en la entrada de The Five Gears Diner.

The Envoy Part I#110.src: Don't worry about the guards, they are disabled for now. Follow me.
The Envoy Part I#110.dst: No te preocupes por los guardias, están desactivados. Sígueme.
The Envoy Part I#110.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#111.src: I know a shortcut, we'll be in {p} in no time.
The Envoy Part I#111.dst: Conozco un atajo, llegaremos a {p} enseguida.
The Envoy Part I#111.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#112.src: Talk to Maxie and Corkus Delegate in {p}.
The Envoy Part I#112.dst: Habla con Maxie y el delegado de Corkus en {p}.

The Envoy Part I#114.src: Beltrude, we have a problem! The factory is running!
The Envoy Part I#114.dst: ¡Beltrude, tenemos un problema! ¡La fábrica está en marcha!
The Envoy Part I#114.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#115.src: We saw a mech... A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
The Envoy Part I#115.dst: Vimos un mech... ¡Un mech nuevo! Parecía distinto, como hecho en-
The Envoy Part I#115.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#116.src: What a load of scrap! You shouldn't talk about that in front of our guest!
The Envoy Part I#116.dst: ¡Menuda chatarra! ¡No hables de eso delante de nuestro invitado!
The Envoy Part I#116.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#117.src: Our guest... just killed several despermechs by himself.
The Envoy Part I#117.dst: Nuestro invitado... ha acabado con varios despermechs él solo.
The Envoy Part I#117.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#118.src: And why would we take the word of someone who can't do basic electromagic?
The Envoy Part I#118.dst: ¿Y por qué creer a alguien que no sabe ni electromagia básica?
The Envoy Part I#118.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#119.src: Don't listen to Maxie. Enjoy your stay.
The Envoy Part I#119.dst: Ignore a Maxie. Disfrute de su estancia.
The Envoy Part I#119.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#120.src: They won't admit anything with you around. They want to become allies with Wynn.
The Envoy Part I#120.dst: No van a admitir nada contigo delante. Quieren ser aliados de Wynn.
The Envoy Part I#120.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#121.src: Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you can get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
The Envoy Part I#121.dst: Ven a mi casa al llegar al nivel {~}; toma una llave para entrar. Debemos preparar el asalto a la fábrica.
The Envoy Part I#121.speaker: Maxie
